meta.description: முழுமையான எல்ஐசி டேர்ம் இன்சூரன்ஸ் வழிகாட்டி — டெக்-டேர்ம், டிஜி டேர்ம் & யுவா டேர்மை ஒப்பிடுக, ₹1 கோடிக்கு மாதிரி பிரீமியங்களைப் பார்க்கவும், எங்கள் கால்குலேட்டரைப் பயன்படுத்தவும், மற்றும் க்ளைம் செயல்முறையை அறியவும். சரியான கவரைத் தேர்ந்தெடுக்க நிபுணர் குறிப்புகள்.

sections.title: Quick take: best LIC term plan for you

content.text: For most buyers who want low cost + trust, LIC New Tech-Term is the best overall choice (lowest online premium). If you want agent help, consider Jeevan Amar. Avoid Return-of-Premium plans unless you prefer guaranteed return over cost efficiency.

sections.title: Which LIC term plans exist (short product list + UINs)
How LIC term premiums are calculated (age, smoker, sum assured, PPT)

content.text: Premiums reflect actuarial risk: younger age = lower premium, smokers pay materially more, higher sum assured costs more, and longer terms increase cost. Use the calculator above for exact quotes tailored to age, gender, smoker status and PPT.

We used live premium examples from market aggregators (PolicyBazaar, PolicyX) for common scenarios (₹50L/₹1Cr, ages 25/30/35; smoker/non-smoker). Use the calculator above to get an exact quote for your profile — premiums differ widely by age and product.

sections.title: LIC vs Private insurers — premium & feature comparison (table)

content.text: LIC combines a nationwide service network and a long history of paying claims, making it the natural choice for buyers who value offline support and brand trust. Recent online plans (Tech-Term, Digi Term) now offer competitive pricing for self-service buyers.
